seo_title: SameTicket: Website Design and Build | The Brandle
summary: A price comparison site for attraction tickets in Dubai and the UAE, built in Astro on Cloudflare.

brief.label: Travel price comparison
brief.heading: The itch
paras: The same Burj Khalifa ticket has one price on the official site and a different one on every reseller. Finding the cheapest means six open tabs and some sums in a hotel lobby.
So we built the site we wanted on holiday. SameTicket shows what each seller charges for the same attraction ticket, cheapest first, always. Commission never changes the order.

answer.label: Launched 2026
answer.heading: The build
paras: We named it, designed it and built it in Astro, hosted on Cloudflare. The home page is a retro travel poster with a 3D paper ticket standing in a field, because a price table on its own never made anyone smile.
Every price shows when it was checked and where it came from. If the prices go stale, the page takes itself out of Google rather than fib to you.
It covers Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah, plus a calculator that tells you whether a Go City pass beats buying single tickets. As the site puts it, a pass only pays if you use it.
